title: Measurement summary
responsibility: Groups recorded size and performance facts in one entity performance profile.

inputs.name: EntitySummary.measure
inputs.description: Required prepared size and performance rows including notes, environment, tolerance and over-policy flags.

inputs.name: EntitySummary.compact
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True hides inline size notes while retaining their tooltips.

outputs.name: EntitySummary
outputs.description: One Performance profile card containing size, complexity and timing measurements. Unavailable measurements stay explicit; workload profiles remain separate and supplied tolerance flags remain visible.
